title: Intent
description: A request from the web module for the agent to perform one action. The web module owns type/item_id/params; the agent owns status/claimed_at/result. Neither writes the other's fields.

id.description: Client-generated unique id. Doubles as the idempotency key: the agent records processed ids and refuses a replay.

type.description: Which action to perform. Must be a key in the agent's REGISTRY; anything else is refused.

item_id.description: For per-file intents, the connector-native id (for the NAS, a path relative to the share root). For the library-wide intents 'index', 'dedup_source', and 'publish', the source name itself.

dest.description: Destination connector, for copy and move.

dest_path.description: Destination sub-path, for copy and move. Defaults to the source filename.

variant.description: fetch_fullres only. 'preview' is a 2048px JPEG (~500 KB) and is what you want for judging a photo; 'original' is the untouched bytes, for downloading the real file.

force.description: thumbnail only. Re-derive even if the blob already exists.

restart.description: index only. Ignore any checkpoint and scan from the beginning.

confirm.description: dedup_source only. Verify candidates by full content hash before archiving. Leaving this on is what makes automatic archiving safe; groups that cannot be confirmed are skipped rather than archived.

min_size.description: dedup_source only. Ignore files smaller than this many bytes.

max_groups.description: dedup_source only. Cap how many duplicate groups one run archives.

max_items.description: publish only. Cap how many un-published items one run pushes.

status.description: Agent-owned. Moves forward only: pending -> claimed -> done|failed.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Set by the web module at write time.

claimed_at.description: Agent-owned. When the claim transaction succeeded. An intent claimed longer ago than the lease (600s) is treated as abandoned and may be reclaimed.

result.description: Agent-owned. The ActionResult, once the action ran. See action.schema.json.
